title: Water closets, urinals, lavatories and bidets.
officialText:
A water closet, urinal, lavatory or bidet shall not be set closer than 15
inches (381 mm) from its center to any side wall, partition, vanity or other obstruction, or closer than 30 inches (762 mm) c enter-
to-center between adjacent fixtures. There shall be at least a 21 inch (533 mm) clearance in front of the water closet, urinal,
lavatory or bidet to any wall, fixture or door. Water closet compartments shall not be less than 30 inches (762 mm) wide and 60
inches (1524 mm) deep (see Figure 405.3.1).
FIGURE 405.3.1
FIXTURE CLEARANCE
For SI: 1 inch = 25.4 mm.
